Rebuilt from the quoted fragments. Merge these into your real files rather than overwriting them blindly.

### scripts/fetch_users.py
```python
import logging

import requests
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

BASE = "https://api.newhost.io/v2"

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s: %(message)s")
log = logging.getLogger("fetch_users")


def make_session():
    retry = Retry(total=3, backoff_factor=0.5,
                  status_forcelist=(429, 500, 502, 503, 504),
                  allowed_methods=("GET",))
    session = requests.Session()
    session.mount("https://", HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry))
    return session


def main():
    url = BASE + "/users"
    log.info("GET %s", url)
    resp = make_session().get(url, timeout=10)
    log.info("Response %s from %s", resp.status_code, url)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
